segments.description: Developing credit history or fair bureau score (avg 634 CIBIL) requiring structured underwriting and risk mitigation.
segments.recommended_action: Enhanced collateral coverage, co-borrower endorsement, and credit-builder structuring.

segments.description: Top-tier household earnings (avg ₹17.5L) with exceptionally low leverage (1.2x LTI) and disciplined debt servicing capacity.
segments.recommended_action: Relationship banking, pre-approved premium limits, and wealth management cross-selling.

segments.description: Pristine credit history (avg 760 CIBIL) with strong repayment track record and balanced retail borrowing needs.
segments.recommended_action: Automated straight-through approval (STP) with competitive prime interest rates.

segments.description: Substantial accumulated asset base (avg ₹1.64 Cr) backing large-ticket mortgage loans with long-tenure structured collateral.
segments.recommended_action: Independent property title search, collateral valuation appraisal, and structured mortgage tenure.

methodology: Features were scaled with StandardScaler. Clusters were identified via k-means clustering with k=4 selected to represent distinct asset-to-debt and credit tiers. Segments use descriptive, non-judgmental classifications.
